about: KnowHippo intervention skill map, Texas K-5 math. Drafted 2026-11-22 from the 246 active Texas K-5 math standards; Counting & Cardinality split 11-22 (to 10, then 11-20); toolkit from Kennady 11-26. Personal Financial Literacy is off the map. Review copy: Claude outputs/hippo-trail-k5-math-skill-map-2026-11-22.xlsx.
